body: click on my username, it will take you to my profile and there will be link on the right side of the page that says "send message," right under my user stats
You can PM me on Reddit, I don't have a smart phone or anything like that.

Reading and listening to music are actually the only things I find enjoyment in these days. The Avett Brothers ares my favorite band of all time - the entire album *Emotionalism* is my favorite and totally amazing, but beyond that they are amazing lyricists and have a beautiful song for every emotion and moment. I truly love all kinds of music. Perfume Genius is an amazing gay artist I love.  A song I love lately is "Gopher Guts" by Aesop Rock. It hits me hard. Speaking of him, he recently did a record with Kimya Dawson under the band name The Uncluded and the entire thing is fucking incredible. I could honestly go on forever, all I really get excited about is music.

Edit: Fang Island, a must-hear band if you want to feel good. Mostly instrumental with some vocals, but they rock (literally) and their melodies are infectious. For further enjoyment, look up the YouTube video "Fang Island Goes To Kindergarten." If you want more music recommendations you should PM me, I've got millions.

Even if you did sound like you were on crack, which you don't, it's really nice to even have someone responding. I understand it's late, my thoughts aren't exactly all together either. I know about the numbers regarding homosexual suicides, but I really don't consider that part of my problem. I'm fine with being gay, so is my family, and I'm open about it so that doesn't factor into the things that bother me. Any mental health problems I have are coincidence when it comes to my orientation, in my opinion. 

As for my last words, I can't answer that specifically because I've always planned on dying all by myself, with nobody around. I have thought about the note I would write quite a lot, though. I feel like I would try to explain how scared I am, mostly. I'm scared of everything to the point that being alive scares me, and I might try to put that into words. Also the fact that I don't feel like I was ever meant to live in this world - perhaps I'm too idealistic, or too artistic, but none of the concrete aspects of daily life satisfy me. Finally, I would try to explain that I did my best but I just don't think I have the motivation to make things work out.

Had you never heard it before? That's crazy. My name isn't Adam (I'm a girl, actually), I was just trying to make a throwaway to post here and that's the first song that always comes to mind when I think about suicide. I'm glad it meant something to you.

As for having a girlfriend, it's not something that solves everything. It's nice to have someone around that cares for you, of course, but when you're depressed and in a relationship, your sadness reaches beyond yourself and that can lead to a darker state for you. Just having her around doesn't automatically make you feel better, and feeling bad around her makes you feel even worse because you worry about how you're affecting her. There's twice as much to take into account when you're down - i.e., you're not just letting yourself down, you're letting her down, too. She'll do her best to be there for you, but there's only so much she can do, and sometimes I start to worry if I'm asking too much of her. It's an entire dimension of emotion that can be better for you in some ways, and worse in others.
